source.primary: UN Comtrade public preview API (comtradeapi.un.org/public/v1/preview/C/A/HS), cmdCode TOTAL and HS4, customsCode C00, motCode 0, partner2 0; primaryValue (CIF imports / FOB exports)
source.fx: ECB SDW EXR.A.USD.EUR.SP00.A annual average (USD per EUR)
source.reporter_rule: Reporter-reported value first; mirror = partner report (Russia own 2021 report; Ukraine own report 2021-2024) as fallback. Russia publishes no partner data after 2021, so trade with Russia 2022+ is always reporter-reported (by the non-Russian country).
source.dual_use_definition: exports_to_RUS_dual_use = reporter exports to Russia summed over HS4 headings 8411,8471,8473,8482,8483,8486,8504,8517,8525,8526,8529,8532,8533,8536,8537,8541,8542,8548,8803,8807,9013,9014 (HS4 PROXY for the EU/US Common High Priority list, which is defined at HS6 -> overstates CHP, especially 8471/8517/8504/8536). HS 8708 (vehicle parts) excluded from the total, given separately as hs8708_*. Values for 2021, 2023, 2024, 2025 where the reporter reported; latest = most recent of 2023-2025 with a reported total for exports to Russia. by_hs4_latest_usd gives raw USD per heading.

SGS.name: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands

notes: All values: UN Comtrade (public preview API), annual, HS, cmdCode TOTAL, retrieved 2026-10-17; converted USD->EUR with ECB annual average USD/EUR (2021 1.1827, 2022 1.0530, 2023 1.0813, 2024 1.0824, 2025 1.1300). Certainty A (official reported data).
Imports valued CIF, exports FOB, as reported; mirror pairs therefore do not match exactly (CIF/FOB, timing, country-of-origin vs consignment, re-exports).

Mirror flags: mirror[indicator][year]=true means the value is the partner's report (Russia's own 2021 report, or Ukraine's own 2021-2024 report), used only when the reporter itself did not report that flow/year.

Russia publishes no partner-level data after 2021: no mirror fallback exists for trade with Russia 2022+. Countries that do not report themselves (e.g. Belarus 2022+, UAE 2024-25, Iran 2024-25, Vietnam 2024-25, Uzbekistan 2025, Bangladesh, Turkmenistan, Syria, Mongolia 2024+, Tajikistan 2024+) therefore show null.
Ukraine's own 2025 annual report is not yet in Comtrade (as of 2026-10-17): 2025 Ukraine flows exist only where the partner reported (121 importers / 103 exporters).

2025 coverage is partial: 116 reporters for imports from Russia, 104 for exports to Russia; all 27 EU members, USA, CHN, IND, TUR, KAZ, KGZ, ARM, GEO, HKG, BRA, ZAF, EGY etc. report 2025. Eurostat was not needed (Comtrade carries all EU27 2025 values).
TWN = Comtrade code 490 "Other Asia, nes" (Taiwan), reported through 2024.
RUS entry: 2021 = Russia's own report vs Ukraine; 2022+ RUS imports_from_UKR/exports_to_UKR are Ukraine's mirror report. UKR entry vs Russia = Ukraine's own report (2023-24 near zero).
Small/non-reporting economies with only mirror 2021 values (from Russia's report) appear with nulls for 2022+.
HKG imports from Russia rise to EUR 11.6bn in 2025 (from 5.9bn in 2024) per HK report - reported value, composition not checked (possibly precious metals); verify before drawing conclusions.

Dual-use proxy is HS4-level and includes legitimate civilian goods; it is an upper-bound indicator, not a measure of sanctioned trade. Values are what the exporting country reports; transshipment via third countries is not visible here.
